title: The Truth Lit Up By the Fireflies
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Agasa -- who voices the deduction here the way Kogoro usually does) omitted by convention; Detective Boys members Ai Haibara and Genta are kept because they are individually plot-relevant (Haibara's resemblance to Narutaki's dead granddaughter Mayu drives his backstory beat and her hostage-taking in the climax; Genta is the one who recovers the disguised voice recorder, the key physical evidence). No `event` nodes: actions are direct typed edges. The old cases/ep577 file got the culprit right (Tarumi, matching this file's label) but was very thin: it omitted Owada Michitake, Narutaki, Haibara's backstory role, Genta, and the victim's father; collapsed all interactions to generic 'knows' edges; left the motive as 'unspecified'; and used two generic event nodes instead of the actual mechanism (voice-recorder alibi trick + bottle swap using a planted firefly). No discrepancy found in the murderer identity itself. Per the 2026-08 batch-8+ process change, order/temporal_frame/years_before_present are omitted from all edges. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: For ~30 minutes after the firefly release, only Aoi and Tarumi were each unaccounted for by any other witness -- everyone else confirmed each other's presence.

The poisoned drink bottle at the scene was scrubbed completely clean, yet a live firefly was found sealed inside the locked car -- the wash job was to hide the swap, and the firefly was planted to explain it.
